title: Void Armageddon/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Cavalero: "Grineer are attacking the Reliquary Drive again. That's waking the Angels. Deploy armaments and keep the Exodampers online. Protect that drive."
- Cavalero: "Corpus attack inbound. They're targeting the reliquary and the Angels will take notice. Build armaments, safeguard the Exodampers, and keep the drive stable."
- Cavalero: "Reliquary ahead. Exodampers blunt enemy capability. They'll target them first."
- Cavalero: "Enemies will hit our Exodampers first so they can fight unimpeded. Then they'll target our Reliquary Drive."
- Cavalero: "Defend the reliquary but don't neglect the Exodampers. Their fields keep enemies on the backfoot."
- Cavalero: "You'll need Argozene. I'm sending you a canister now."
- Cavalero: "Reckon you could use more Argozene?"
- Cavalero: "You got some Argozene. Go build."
- Cavalero: "The more Argozene you have, the more armaments you can construct."
- Cavalero: "Do not let this wave of scum take out that Exodamper."
- Cavalero: "They're hitting an Exodamper. Hit them first."
- Cavalero: "They're throwing more losers at you."
- Cavalero: "Don't let up. More no-marks incoming."
**If at least one Exodamper has been destroyed**
- Cavalero: "Enemy have exposed our reliquary. Get it defended!"
- Cavalero: "Not done yet. More coming. Prioritize the reliquary!"
- Cavalero: "You kept that Exodamper standing. Good work."
- Cavalero: "The Exodamper made it, but they'll be back."
- Cavalero: "Exodamper down! You just gave them a clear path to the drive!"
- Cavalero: "Exodamper disabled. Do a better job protecting the drive."
- Cavalero: "Exodamper out of action. Watch that flank!"
- Cavalero: "Took down an Exodamper. Getting stronger."
- Cavalero: "One less Exodamper, that's a boost to the enemy."

path: Ravenous Angel Spawn After Three Waves
lines: - Cavalero: "Confirming a Void Angel at your location."
- Cavalero: "Reading Void Angel signature heading right for the reliquary."
- Cavalero: "A Void Angel just woke up and is looking to snack on the relic."
- Cavalero: "Grubber, the Angel is trying to retreat into the Void so it can heal. Follow it and stop it."

path: Dimensional Orbs Spawn And Ethereal Angel Invincible
lines: - Cavalero: "You can't hurt it while those dimensional orbs are out. Use your Void body to absorb them."
- Cavalero: "The Angel's almost recovered. Hurry this up!"
- Cavalero: "Good. Now it will stay hurt."
- Cavalero: "That's the way. Break it down, body and soul."
- Cavalero: "Yes. It won't be shrugging that off."
- Cavalero: "You weren't fast enough. Now it's healed."
- Cavalero: "Stop that Angel now or we're all finished!"
- Cavalero: "Stop that Void Angel from feeding, Grubber!"
- Cavalero: "Good work Grubber. Here's where we divide the spoils. Extract if you want or hold out for more."
- Cavalero: "Won us some breathing space and a share of what we were able to loot from them. Extract when you are ready."
- Cavalero: "They committed so many troops to this attack they forgot to defend their crewships. Here's your share. You're clear to extract."
- Cavalero: "The longer you hold the fort, the more we can loot from our would-be boarders. Hope you're having as much as I am."
- Cavalero: "While you're keeping them busy, we're helping ourselves to their stuff. You get a cut of course."
- Cavalero: "All the fighting down there in Oro Works is one hell of a useful distraction."
- Cavalero: "Hey, look what uncle Cavalero found."
- Cavalero: "I'll put this on the pile."
- Cavalero: "Hey don't let success go to your head."
- Cavalero: "Don't even think of throwing in the towel now."
- Cavalero: "You got to wonder what possessed these goons thinking they could gain mastery over the Void. Maybe some of them are possessed."
- Cavalero: "There's some kind of a fire in these no-hopers pushing them. And I can't work it out."
- Cavalero: "These wasters fighting like their lives don't matter. They're driven. I've seen that kind of fury on this ship before, once."
- Cavalero: "Don't give these fools your slaughter a second thought. The Void's already starting to take them. I can feel it."
- Cavalero: "That Angel is full up. It's over. Get out of there."
- Cavalero: "That Angel compromised the reliquary. Retreat and regroup."
- Cavalero: "It's over, damn it. The Angel's fed. This is my fault."
- Cavalero: "The relic's taking a pounding, Grubber. You're meant to stop that."
- Cavalero: "The relic cannot endure this amount of punishment. Do better!"
- Cavalero: "If they destabilize the relic, this mission's a failure. It cannot defend itself."
- Cavalero: "They're ripping that relic wide open!"
- Cavalero: "Relic's barely hanging on, Grubber. Hope you got a miracle in you."
- Cavalero: "Relic is almost destabilized. This is not sustainable."

path: If no rounds completed / Mission Failure
lines: - Cavalero: "They destablized the relic. We're done."
- Cavalero: "Reliquary compromised. Get your stuff and clear out. We've failed."
- Cavalero: "This was all too much for you. They won, we lost. Go lick your wounds."

path: If at least one round completed
lines: - Cavalero: "You let them destabilize the relic, but it will recover with time. Get out of there while you still have skin."
- Cavalero: "Reliquary compromised. Nothing more you can do. Find self-extraction."
- Cavalero: "It's over. Nothing more you can do right now. Self-extract and regroup."
- Cavalero: "Reliquary is secure. You did good Grubber."
- Cavalero: "Reliquary is safe. Don't go looking all smug about it."
- Cavalero: "Not bad. Room for improvement, but not bad."
